name: Applied Linear Algebra / Прикладна лінійна алгебра
ai_policy: AI allowed for learning only. FORBIDDEN when directly solving or writing up homework and tests (grade cancelled). Never work on the actual homework problems — use different problems. Labs: code written without ready-made fragments.
assessment: Quizzes: 8 x 2 points, weekly at the start of the first practice of the week (Group 2 dates on Moodle)
Homework: 4 x 6 points, handwritten, one PDF; one late day; early submission 3 days before gets preliminary feedback
Labs: 3 x 12 (6 code, 4 defense, 2 theory); no defense = max 50%
Final test: 30 (one handwritten one-sided A4 cheat sheet, definitions/formulas only)
Grading: full reasoning required; correct answer without reasoning = 25%
notes: The student's group runs on different dates than the syllabus; always take dates from Moodle. Books: Olver & Shakiban 'Applied Linear Algebra', Strang, Axler, Liesen & Mehrmann.

topics.title: Systems of linear equations, Gaussian elimination, determinants (recap)
Elementary matrices, LU decomposition and solving systems with it
Linear operators, matrix of an operator, kernel, range, four fundamental subspaces
Diagonalization of a square matrix and its applications
Inner products, inner product spaces, orthogonal and orthonormal vectors
Orthogonal projections, Fundamental Theorem of Linear Algebra
QR decomposition and the least squares method
Symmetric matrices, spectral theorem, quadratic forms and definiteness
Singular value decomposition (SVD) and its applications
